dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Ahem, well, even though it's nothing compared to the Palace of Alcazarzaray...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I suppose it could suffice as my backup base. It'll do.

choices.text: "It'll do"? C'mon, it's gotta be better than that...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Puh-lease, merely receiving a compliment from the wise and mighty Lord Sangemah Bay...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: You're certainly a cut above the average artless toadstool!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: But, if the knowledgeable Lord Sangemah Bay is to serve as a renovation consultant for this place...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: You'll need some Mora, a LOT of Mora...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: No rush, though. I'm sure you'll save enough Mora... someday.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: I suppose I might stay here a little longer, now that there's an opportunity to earn big Mora, hehe.

choices.text: How do I take it from "It'll do" to "It's amazing"?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Oh? You mean... you mean, what'll it take for it to beat the Palace of Alcazarzaray as my primary base?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Wow, good to see my young apprentice show some ambition for once.
